table.name: attendance
table.purpose: Junction/association table linking events (t03) to people (t07), likely event attendance or participation records. Each row represents one person's association with one event. The table itself has no primary key detected and no descriptive columns of its own, consistent with a pure join table (e.g., Airtable-style record IDs referencing two lookup tables).

col_001.name: event_id
col_001.description: Reference to an event record in t03 (labels like 'Officers meeting - March', 'Habitat for Humanity', 'Lacrosse game', 'Food Bank', 'Spring Budget Review' suggest a club/organization's event or activity list). Many-to-one: many rows in t01 point to the same event.

col_002.name: person_id
col_002.description: Reference to a person record in t07 (labels are first names: Randy, Emily, Tyler, Keith, Elijah). Many-to-one: many rows in t01 point to the same person.

table.name: event_budget_line_items
table.purpose: Budget line items for club/organization events (food, advertising, parking, gifts), tracking budgeted amount, amount paid, and remaining balance per expense category, linked to an event table (t03). Status column tracks whether the line item is open, closed, or in planning. The pattern col_003 + col_004 = col_005 (e.g. 67.81 + 7.19 = 75) confirms paid + remaining = budgeted.

col_001.name: line_item_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID) for each budget line item.

col_002.name: expense_category
col_002.description: Category of the expense: Food, Advertisement, Parking, Speaker Gifts, Club T-Shirts.

col_003.name: amount_paid
col_003.description: Amount already paid/spent on this line item (0 for most items, up to 327.07). Together with col_004 it sums to the budgeted amount col_005.

col_004.name: amount_remaining
col_004.description: Remaining unspent balance of the line item's budget; equals col_005 minus col_003. Negative values (min -24.25) indicate overspending beyond the budgeted amount.

col_005.name: budgeted_amount
col_005.description: Total budgeted amount for the line item (10 to 350); equals amount paid plus remaining.

col_006.name: status
col_006.description: Workflow status of the line item: Open, Closed, or Planning.

col_007.name: event_id
col_007.description: Foreign key to t03 (events table, e.g. 'Habitat for Humanity', 'Lacrosse game', 'Spring Budget Review'); each event has multiple budget line items.

table.name: event
table.purpose: Club/organization event schedule: each row is an event (meeting, game, community service, social, election) with its date/time, type, description, location, and planning status. Dates span an academic year (2075-09 to 2076-05). Referenced by t01 and t02, likely attendance/participation records for these events.

col_001.name: event_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID) for each event. Referenced by t01.col_001 and t02.col_007.

col_002.name: event_name
col_002.description: Name/title of the event, e.g. 'Officers meeting - March', 'Lacrosse game', 'Habitat for Humanity'.

col_003.name: event_datetime
col_003.description: Date and time the event occurs (ISO timestamps, 2075-09-01 through 2076-05-05).

col_004.name: event_type
col_004.description: Category of event: Meeting, Guest Speaker, Game, Community Service, Social, Budget, Election, etc. (8 distinct values).

col_005.name: description
col_005.description: Free-text description of the event (attendance rules, volunteer details). Null for about half the rows, mainly simple meetings/games.

col_006.name: location
col_006.description: Location of the event: campus rooms (e.g. 'MU 215'), campus sports facilities, or street addresses. Null for ~14% of rows.

table.name: expense
table.purpose: Expense/transaction records for club or event purchases (food, shirts, posters, parking, etc.), each row an individual expense item with amount, date, submitter, and expense category. Likely a club treasury/expenses table (Airtable-style record IDs).

col_001.name: expense_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID) for each expense row.

col_002.name: item_description
col_002.description: Free-text description of what was purchased (e.g. 'Pizza', 'Posters', 'Club shirts', 'Water, chips, cookies', 'Parking').

col_003.name: expense_date
col_003.description: Date of the expense, ranging 2075-08-20 to 2075-11-19 (dates appear shifted to a future year, likely anonymized/synthetic data).

col_004.name: amount
col_004.description: Expense amount in currency units (min 6.0, max 295.12, mean ~65.19).

col_005.name: approved
col_005.description: Boolean flag stored as text; 'true' for all non-null rows (31/32), one null. Plausibly an approval/reimbursed flag, but since only one value occurs, its exact meaning is uncertain.

col_006.name: member_id
col_006.description: Reference to t07 (people table with first-name labels like Randy, Emily, Tyler, Keith, Elijah) — the member who submitted/incurred the expense.

col_007.name: category_id
col_007.description: Reference to t02, a lookup of expense categories (labels include Advertisement, Food, Parking) — the expense category for the row.

table.name: club_member_dues_payments
table.purpose: Records of member payments/dues collected by a student club, with payment date, amount, source category, optional note, and the paying member (referencing a people table t07).

col_001.name: payment_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec' id) for each payment row.

col_002.name: payment_date
col_002.description: Date the payment was received, ranging 2075-09-01 to 2075-10-31 (a fall semester window; the 2075 year is likely synthetic/test data).

col_003.name: amount
col_003.description: Payment amount in currency units. 33 of 36 rows are 50 (the standard dues amount); the other values (200, 1000, 3000) correspond to the non-Dues source categories (Fundraising, Sponsorship, School Appropriation).

col_004.name: payment_source
col_004.description: Category of the funds: 'Dues' (33 rows), plus one each of 'Fundraising', 'Sponsorship', and 'School Appropration' (sic, likely 'School Appropriation').

col_005.name: notes
col_005.description: Optional note describing the purpose of the payment (e.g. 'Annual funding from Student Government.'). Only present on the 3 non-Dues rows.

col_006.name: member_id
col_006.description: Reference to a person/member in t07 (lookup shows first names like Randy, Emily, Tyler). Most members appear once; a couple appear twice, consistent with recurring dues payments.

table.name: academic_programs
table.purpose: Catalog of academic majors/programs at a university (likely Utah State University given department names), each row one program with its department and college. Referenced by t07 (probably students or enrollments).

col_001.name: program_id
col_001.description: Primary key; Airtable-style record id (rec...). Referenced by t07.col_009, which likely assigns students/enrollments to a program.

col_002.name: program_name
col_002.description: Name of the academic major/program (e.g., History, Environmental Engineering, Social Work). Unique per row.

col_003.name: department
col_003.description: Department or school administering the program (e.g., History Department, School of Accountancy).

col_004.name: college
col_004.description: College the program belongs to (e.g., College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences, College of Engineering).

table.name: members
table.purpose: Roster of organization/club members with contact info, membership status, shirt size, and links to a location (t08) and another entity (t06). Likely a student organization at 'lpu.edu'. Referenced by t01, t04, t05 (e.g., attendance, payments, orders).

col_001.name: member_id
col_001.description: Primary key; Airtable-style record id (rec...). Referenced by t01, t04, t05.

col_005.name: membership_status
col_005.description: Role/status in the organization: Member, Inactive, President, Secretary, Treasurer.

col_006.name: shirt_size
col_006.description: T-shirt size: Small, Medium, Large, X-Large.

col_008.name: zip_code
col_008.description: US ZIP code (1000-98290); one-to-one join to t08.col_001, likely a ZIP/location lookup.

table.name: us_locations
table.purpose: US postal locations (cities/towns/ZIP code areas) with county and state, keyed by an ID referenced by t07. Likely a ZIP-code/place reference table (e.g., USPS ZIP code database).

col_001.name: location_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique integer ID (501-99950, likely a ZIP code or ZIP-derived ID) for each postal location. Referenced one-to-one by t07.col_008.

col_002.name: zip_type
col_002.description: USPS ZIP code type: Standard, PO Box, or Unique.

col_003.name: city
col_003.description: City or place name for the location.

col_004.name: county
col_004.description: County (or county-equivalent such as Borough, Municipio, Census Area) name; ~0.2% null.

col_005.name: state_name
col_005.description: Full US state/territory name (52 distinct incl. DC and Puerto Rico).

col_006.name: state_code
col_006.description: Two-letter USPS state/territory abbreviation, matching col_005.
